release_notes: Orbitra 2.1.7: Analytics -> Reports gains Domain as a grouping dimension (historical attribution from clicks.domain, case-normalized, blank rows grouped as Unknown) plus a Domain -> Campaign preset; report filters now support all report dimensions and multi-value IN / NOT IN operators (including rollup seam support); active filter pills appear in the Reports toolbar; fixed bot, proxy, unique stream/global, and registration/deposit metric rollups in the Reports table and Totals row.
